column1: # Every differential fuzz run, oldest first. run.sh appends a row when it finishes.
# Rows before 2026-08-02 were recovered from the log each commit carried, because
# run.sh used to only overwrite fuzz/log*.txt and the earlier runs were not visible
# in a checkout. Divergence-finding runs are not rows: their logs were replaced by
# the fix commit. Both are in decisions.md, with reproducers in tests/port/corpus/.
